name: Apex EOD 50K
source: Account holder 2026-09-27: "the EOD trail apex with the max 6 con", $3,000 target, $2,000 EOD-trailing max loss, $1,000 daily loss limit, no consistency rule, passable in 1 day, floor locks at +$100. The daily limit is modelled SOFT (closed out and stopped for the day, the account survives), the same as Lucid's -- confirm if Apex's differs. Floor: $2,000 below the EOD peak, locking at $50,100 (+$100) once the EOD peak reaches +$2,100.
notes: Max size 6 minis = 60 micros. NOT enforced by the simulator.
Trailing max loss is END OF DAY: the floor moves up with the EOD peak and never down, and locks at +$100 ($50,100) once EOD profit reaches +$2,100.
No consistency rule and no minimum days: a single +$3,000 day passes.
SOFT daily loss limit $1,000, applied per trade from each trade's tick-level worst moment (MAE); stopped for the day, account survives.

FUNDED/PAYOUT block (win_day, payout_win_days, payout_share, payout_cap, max_payout_profit) is COPIED FROM LUCIDFLEX as a placeholder -- Apex's own payout rules were not given, so the 'Funded: expected cheque' figure is NOT Apex's. That is the only unconfirmed part of this file.
